column1: # Accepted / known divergences for the genieoracle fuzzers (reference/fuzz_*.rb).
# Read by oracle_env.rb. A fuzzer exits 1 if any diff matches NO entry.
# UMBRELLA entries (input regex `/./` or `/\A/`, OracleEnv::UMBRELLA_SOURCES) match every input,
# so they cannot catch a regression in their bucket: corpus_oracle and the default-seed
# fuzz_eval_grammar run are gated by EXACT accepted keys instead (reference/goldens/
# *.accepted.<tree>.tsv, OracleEnv.finish); there the umbrellas only tag keys at --accept time.
# Other runs that pass through an umbrella print a WARNING. curate_oracle_golden.rb ignores
# Columns (TAB-separated): fuzzer  tree  mode  /regex on the input/  /regex on Genie's output/ or *  finding  note
#   fuzzer/tree/mode may be `*`. tree = remix | upstream. Keep entries narrow and tag
#   each with the finding id whose work package will remove it; delete the entry when
#   that WP lands (an entry with 0 hits across seeds is a candidate for removal).
